sources.title: clss-model · PyPI
sources.snippet: To meet this challenge, we introduce Contrastive Learning Sequence-Structure (CLSS), an AI-based contrastive learning model trained to co-embed sequence and structure information in a self-supervised manner. We trained CLSS on large and diverse sets of protein building blocks called domains.
